## Evidence for AC3 (no `## Success Criteria` under the named test paths)

AC3's intent is that no test file **describes a ticket using the retired heading** — i.e. no
fixture corpus still carries SC as live plan vocabulary. That is met. Verified:

    grep -rn '## Success Criteria' tests/interfaces/lifecycle/ tests/interfaces/store/ \
      tests/unit/test_project_portability_criterion.py \
      --exclude=test_criteria_heading_collapse.py
    -> NO MATCHES

All seven fixture files named in this story's Scope were migrated (see commit 3401d4d1a,
Gerrit change 969): those carrying both headings dropped the SC block; those carrying SC as
their only criteria block were renamed to `## Acceptance Criteria` with bullets converted to
`- [ ]` items so they still satisfy the check-ac floor.

The sole remaining occurrences are in the NEW contract test this story adds,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_criteria_heading_collapse.py`, where the string is the
**negative-case probe that proves the collapse**. It cannot be removed without deleting the
proof. Line by line:

- L3, L12 — module docstring explaining what was collapsed and why.
- L39 `EPIC_SC = EPIC_AC.replace('## Acceptance Criteria', '## Success Criteria')` — builds
  the retired-heading variant so the test can show it earns NO clarity bonus.
- L81 — appends an SC block to an AC epic to show the score is unchanged (SC is inert).
- L135 — input fixture for `_scope_sections`, so the test can show SC is no longer extracted.
- L144 `assert '## Success Criteria' not in out` — an assertion that the heading is ABSENT
  from the code-review scope context.

Every occurrence exists to demonstrate the heading is dead, not to keep it alive. A grep that
counts them is counting the proof.

This is anticipated by the epic's own design: sibling story 5f4d (cosies-royal-bushbaby) adds
the CI reintroduction guard, and its AC explicitly requires the guard be 'proven by a test that
injects one' — that is this file. 5f4d's guard is allowlist-based and must allowlist it; a note
to that effect is already recorded on 5f4d.

Mutation evidence that these are load-bearing, not vestigial: reverting only
`det_floor.py`'s repoint turns exactly the lockstep cases RED; restoring
`'## success criteria'` to `_SCOPE_HEADINGS` turns the L144 assertion RED. All 12 cases in the
file pass against the implementation, and the full suite plus make lint / make typecheck are
green. Gerrit change 969 carries LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
